column5: GROUP: **psi-terminal-production** | 25. `tp/build_bindings.rs:33-41`: a `Name` root matching zero or several machines yields root `None`, not an error.
GROUP: **psi-terminal-production** | 26. `tp/lib.rs:173-177`: per-instance calling-policy failures are stored as `Err` data; consumer not read.
GROUP: **psi-terminal-production** | 27. `tp/lib.rs:188-198`: `boundary_application` returns `None` for any machine that is not `ExternalRealization` and has no `abi_for_boundary`.

GROUP: **facts** | 28. `fa/lib.rs:1859-1867`: `places_match` returns true for places with equal bare-name labels. Wrong program a reader named: two distinct locals or fields with the same spelling, so a domain-membership fact on one satisfies a requirement on the other through `proves_place_domain_membership_in_program` (`c&p:1062`). Six external callers in Psi 05 were not read. (checked: code matches.)

GROUP: **facts** | 29. `fa/lib.rs:1466`, `:1479`: an unresolvable member becomes a field segment with an invalid symbol; two such segments are equal, so `a.x` and `a.y` with both unresolved have equal segment lists.
GROUP: **facts** | 30. `fa/predicates.rs:100-125`: with `maximum_length < bytes.len()` only the first bytes are compared; whether the predicate is used as an assumption or a requirement is open.

GROUP: **checked-trees** | 31. `c&o:109`, `:112-114`: an unsupported constant-predicate shape is not retained as a pending per-target obligation; callers not read. Wrong program a reader named: a target-dependent predicate over an unsupported shape is not re-checked per target.
GROUP: **checked-trees** | 32. `c&o:189`: discharge treats every binary node as builtin; reachable only if captured nodes differ from those `retain` checked.
